given: One or more stock records have been filed for distinct (sku, location) pairs
when: The team member opens the home stock-by-location table
then: Each filed record appears as a row showing its SKU, its location, and its quantity
architectural_notes: Read path: home stock-by-location view -> app/routes boundary -> StockService -> StockRepository read against the paired branch, then the rendered table, so E2E. Lists the records filed by S1; no new persistence.
